steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Operator Noir Corne, report your status.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I can't reach him... The signal's too weak.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I prefer not to shoulder unnecessary burdens while on a mission, so if you can't keep up with my pace, please remain where you are, or return to the camp.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You fool, who said I was travelling with you?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If you're pursuing the Rathalos, then please don't leave my side without permission. I need to ensure your safety.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You little—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Palico, keep going.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mrow, so here's what happened.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The Hunter I was following had accepted a commission from a member of the Royal Family. They seemed to be in a bad mood, and were looking for a Rathalos Ruby to fashion into a brooch.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A bad mood... you were hunting a Rathalos on such a whim?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: ...That client should be just considered an example.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: To return to my main point, I furst spotted this Rathalos in the forest near a volcano.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Right as I was about to catch up to it, I was suddenly swept away by a strange force, and by the time I had made sense of things I was already here.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Do you remember what kind of force it was?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Unfortunately, my... meowmories of it are vague at best.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A power capable of bringing over a Rathalos could be considered an even greater threat... but in the interest of time, please continue.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I was still extremely unfurmiliar with the environment here when I arrived, so I chose to continue tracking the Rathalos and discreetly observe its behavior.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Based on what I've seen, it started behaving abnormally after it discovered a cave entrance and went inside.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A cave entrance? Leading into the mountain?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Purrcisely.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Was there anything distinctive about it?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Unfurtunately, it appeared to be a regular cave from what I could tell, but the Rathalos did start behaving strangely after entering.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I took a cursory stroll inside, only to find...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The cave network is purrticularly complex, and my several attempts to locate the Rathalos were all in vain.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: My purrsumption is that it has occupied an area within the cave to build a nest, which should be a wide space near the entrance.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Based on what we saw in the cave behind Roka Village, these caves should all be interconnected, so it's no surprise the Rathalos showed up.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's one more thing I'd like to know. As you've seen, our previous fight with the Rathalos was not at all easy. In fact, you could call it... difficult.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We've yet to effectively deal any damage, so I find it hard to be optimistic about our next encounter. I fear we may have to pay a considerable price for victory.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So what I want to ask... based on your knowledge of the Rathalos, how do we ensure a victory in our next battle?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Or to put it another way, is there any way to improve our chances?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: It's hard to judge... Compared to a typical Rathalos, this one is highly agitated and shows a strong tendency to attack at the slightest pawvocation.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Earlier, I noticed that its senses have also improved, which is correlated with a change in its attack patterns. This is the basis for my assumption that its behavior is abnormal... Mrow.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Neither of us have Flash Bombs nor Shock Traps in our pawsernal, so I am at a loss as to how to trap it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So you're saying... our chances remain low?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I do have some ideas on how to boost the damage we deal to it, for I have observed... your meowjesty seems to lack instruction on the use of your Dual Blades?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Dual Blades...you're referring to these strange pair of weapons? True, I do feel a lack of strength behind my blows when wielding them.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: These pair in your paws seem to be weapons from our world, and of extremely good quality... So mew can at least rest assured they were crafted by one of our finest craftsmen.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mrow?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: I can explain to you the key to using your Dual Blades. If mew can manage to wield them correctly, mew will be able to deal substantially more damage to the Rathalos, but...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Before that, my observations have led me to ask the critical question: Is it truly necessary to hunt it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You mean that we shouldn't kill it?

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: My understanding is that pawerful Hunters are usually the key to meowntaining a balanced ecology. Hunting of any kind will have an effect, and the consequences must be carefully considered before any action is taken.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: According to my observations so fur, the Rathalos's activity range is quite far from the village, so it does not pose a significant threat to them, and moreover... The ecology of this area seems to be quite unbalanced.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: The area is clearly overpawpulated by herbivores, judging from the obvious damage to the forest vegetation, so the Rathalos's ability to keep the herbivores in check could be considered a pawsitive.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: If I was back in my homeland and had already obtained my commission meowterials, I would not choose to hunt harmless meownsters.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: To be clear, my mission isn't to hunt the Rathalos either, but to deal with another deadly threat—Oripathy. And our current clues point to the Rathalos as the source.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The fate of the monster is irrelevant to me, as long as we can identify the source of the disease and eliminate the threat it poses to the village.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You lot...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So in order to determine the cause, we must—

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You lot!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ignore him.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: It's all... your fault!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: (Raises hunting spear)

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Kuso! It's all your fault!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau, what are you trying to do?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Why? Why don't any of you listen to me?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Why?! You... You just had to break into the forest and run around like a pack of brainless beasts.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Just look at yourselves, you are powerless before that monster, yet still you want to hinder me, block my way, chase after MY quarry. And still you talk about wanting to protect whatever it is...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: But the truth is, that boy is missing because you didn't listen to me, and that monster is still alive and well!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We're still in the early stages of figuring out countermeasures, so a failure or two should be unsurprising.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What would you even know? Only trash like you would say it couldn't be done!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And now you're saying you shouldn't hunt it at all, hiding behind some nonsensical, cowardly excuse? I suppose next you'll even want to rescue it from me, yes?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Now I understand... You're here to torture me, aren't you? To purposely torment me, an old man not long for this world...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: All because I still remember him! Remember the things you lot insist on forgetting! That's why you're torturing me like this!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Just like you did to him! Strip my skin, drain my blood, break my ribs, cut open my chest, extract my marrow...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Well...? Say something!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Sorry, I have no idea where to start with that rant.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Just put down your weapon and let's move on. We don't have the time to waste on irrelevant small talk.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Don't move!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What can you even do?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Begone from my sight! Crawl back to wherever you came from!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm ordering you! Get lost!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Not happening.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I will repeat myself, I have no reason to obey your orders.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Nandayo? Why is this happening again?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Unwilling to listen to even a single word of advice... yet still wanting to protect others?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: With your meager abilities? Self-righteous fool! All you can do is impose your will on others!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No one needs your protection! Those who take action should suffer the consequences! They deserved what was coming to them!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Everyone else should mind their own business! Fuzakeru na! You should have just stood by and watched!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm the only one... who can hunt that monster... I'm the only one who deserves to...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: If... If you dare take another step forward, I'll have you taste the tip of this spear!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, you won't.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You don't have the guts to.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What you say means little to me... That hunting spear in your hands... I barely see it as a threat.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: See? I've been approaching you, and yet your spear has not moved an inch.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This is your last warning!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Just give it up already, you can't do it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Since you insist on delaying my progress, I'll have to settle this with you in a way that will remove the possibility of future interference.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What... Stop!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If you really walked your talk, you would have disposed of me and Noir Corne while we were wounded, satisfying your desire to have the beast all to yourself. But you didn't.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You... don't come any closer!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I can understand the reluctance to strike at your own kind. Since the beginning I've felt that all your actions were only to dissuade us.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Not long ago, you even pushed me away from the Rathalos... You don't actually want us to be in danger.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Nonsense!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Stop! I'm warning you, this is the last time!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: To return to the subject of hunting, as a hunter, isn't your top priority to eradicate the threat your prey poses at the least possible cost?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And yet, you've been fighting against such a huge predator for so long. Apparently you disagree.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You've consistently refused my offers to work together, insisting on facing it alone despite your lack of ability, in the process putting the safety of the entire village at risk. Which clearly contradicts your attempts to protect us from harm.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm starting to suspect that your Rathalos hunt is nothing more than a personal obsession.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Damare!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Judging at your expression, I must have hit the mark.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Then I take that nothing you've done has actually been to eliminate the threat, but instead you've been blindly chasing it out of anger and remorse.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Which is, in a word, selfish.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The way I see, you're not much of a hunter at all.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That... That was my quarry all along! You're no hunter, so who are you to judge?!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Stop this! Just stop it already!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If you wish to refute anything I've said, then just thrust forward with that spear of yours and you'll have everything you say you want. It's as simple as that.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm right here, right in front of you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Come on.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kill me.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What exactly is source of your obsession, Kashiwau?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is it Akira Kashiwau?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You... Where did you hear that name?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm guessing that he's not in the village anymore, correct?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What is his relation to you? You share a surname, so clearly more than friends. From the photo he seemed younger than both you and the village headman, as well as a former hunter. His name is also etched onto the hunting spear you're holding.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So, a relative?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Stop talking...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You keep referring to me in the plural. Is it because your image of him overlaps with me somehow?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm guessing that... he once went on a hunt against your advice, leading to irreparable consequences including him leaving you somehow.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Since then, you've regretted your decision and been haunted by the pain... And you can only vent your frustrations on the hunt.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Damare! You... know absolutely nothing...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I think I do, actually.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It can be hard, being caught up in the past, but those emotions will only impair your judgement. Your obsessions will never change the past, but they will keep you from moving forward.

spans.text: It can be hard, being caught up in the past, but those emotions will only impair your judgement. Your obsessions will never change the past, but they

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But open your eyes and take a good look. Is this really the time to be rambling about the past to a stranger?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If you can't bring yourself to kill me, then we should put aside our differences and work together on this hunt.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I still trust you are a somewhat capable hunter, so if you agree I'm willing to put this all behind us.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And we can finally stop wasting time on this sort of nonsense.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No...you don't know a thing at all...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Akira... is my son...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: He’s already dead.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Seven years ago, on this day, on a night just like tonight, the mountains were filled with the cries of those beasts.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I told him not to go, that those guys were asking for it, but no matter how much I warned him, he just kept saying...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: 'No, I am a hunter of the village.' He just kept saying that, over and over again, before rushing out without looking back.

spans.text: 'No, I am a hunter of the village.' He just kept
that, over and over again, before rushing out without looking back.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Later, when I finally saw him again, it was far too late for him to say anything more.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Do you know? If it weren't his clothes and equipment, I wouldn't have recognized him at all.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The sun was shining on his body, and yet his hands were so cold.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I don't understand. My son, how did he end up like that?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I saw them... Ataru Takii... and the backs of those bakayarou...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I just knew it, they were all there when it happened, but they didn't do a thing! They just... watched my son...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: So how... How could you possibly understand my pain...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: (The tip of the spear is trembling so much now, as is his paw...)

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: (His fingers are moving towards, that's... mrow!)

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Careful, your meowjesty! He's about to shoot his spear!

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Mroaw! I caught it!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Let go!
I heard the sharp wind in my eardrums as beads of blood dripped down from small scratches on my ear.
The spearhead was stuck by my left foot, and half buried in the ground.
When I turned around, I saw the old man's clouded... shaky eyes.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: How... could I...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm fine, calm down...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Stay away!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No, it wasn't me... It's your own fault...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You! And you! This is all of your fault, all of you!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau... agh—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Anguished gasping)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hah, augh, this was... from the Rathalos earlier...

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: Your meowjesty, what's wrong, why can't you stand? The situation—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Leave me! After him, Palico!
